title: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Apes can be gentle, contemplative beasts—but context is everything.
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall." —Eladamri, Lord of Leaves
"The Cloud Nacatl sit and think, a bunch of soft paws. We are the Claws of Marisi, stalking, pouncing, drawing blood."
In Zendikar, today's grassland could be tomorrow's jungle, and hunting grounds change as quickly as the weather.
"Relative of yours?" Ertai teased. Mirri simply sneered.
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons." —Jade creed
"Not all paths are found on the forest floor."
"When one of us prospers, the pride prospers." —Jazal Goldmane
An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago." —Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist
One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.
"I have lived long, and I remember how this city once was. If my death serves to bring back the Ravnica in my memory, then so be it."
"I knew a creature carved from a dream of wild freedom. Any attempt to leash or exploit it failed, and at terrible cost." —Ashling
"Looks like we're completely outnumbered." "Lucky for us. I thought we'd be bored."
Tel-Jilad's sworn protectors are the trolls, yet more fearsome protectors were created by the Tangle itself.
There's only one thing worse than a hungry lion—many hungry lions.
"We must hunt and kill the dragon before it can return to raze our ancient city."
"He hasn't returned to the Cloud Forest. But I can still sense his calming presence." —Zaliki of Naya
"Rage is not the answer. Rage followed by fitting vengeance is the answer." —Ajani
Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.
"When I meditate I see the world as it should be. All that does not fit, I remove." —Alovnek, Boros guildmage
"May this grant you all the strength of the behemoths and none of their serenity." —Ajani
Deep in nature's core lies a potential unsullied by greed or civilization.
Some who scouted new lands chose to stay.
"Retribution is best delivered by claws and rage, with both magnified." —Ajani
Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.
On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.
In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.
Their natural curiosity, combined with a knack for trespassing, makes sprites excellent spies.
Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.
Having lost their minds, they now want yours.
"The toads of Urborg aren't fast, powerful, or pleasant, but they have their uses." —Ertai
There is no fondness between the hound and its master. There is only a common appreciation of the hunt.
Other guilds demand tolls from those who travel their territories, but not House Dimir. It takes its share secretly, one coin purse at a time.
Like many Izzet creations, weirds are based on wild contradictions yet somehow manage to work.
"Touched by moroii" —Undercity slang meaning "to grow old"
He's an oxymoron.
"This creature is inadequate. Send it to the splicers for innovation." —Malcator, Executor of Synthesis
"The essence of every world, every spell, and every thought is power. Nothing else matters, because nothing else exists." —Nicol Bolas
Like most features of Grixis, the obelisks that remain from the time of Alara now exist only for dark exploitation.
Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.
"Which would you like first, the insult or the injury?"
"So many choices. Shall I choose loathing, hate, or malice today?" —Eliza of the Keep
In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.
"No fact escapes me. Why do you think you can?"
Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.
Taste his power, hunger for his command.
There is always a greater power.
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living." —Olcot, Rider of Joffik
Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.
